differences.a_observable: The blue hyperswitch button has a highly saturated, deep royal blue color.
differences.b_observable: The blue hyperswitch button is a lighter, less saturated blue.
differences.fix: Adjust the color grading and material properties of the blue button to match the deep royal blue of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center, creating a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are almost as bright as the center, with very little vignette.
differences.fix: Add a post-processing vignette effect to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The shadows on the background grid are deep and have high contrast, giving a strong sense of depth.
differences.b_observable: The shadows on the background grid are faint and washed out, resulting in a flatter look.
differences.fix: Adjust the shadow intensity and contrast curve to deepen the shadows on the background.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Match the deep royal blue color of the hyperswitch button and increase the overall contrast and vignette to match the reference.

differences.a_observable: The blue button on the right is a lighter, less saturated blue.
differences.b_observable: The blue button on the right is a highly saturated royal blue.
differences.fix: Desaturate and lighten the blue button material.

differences.a_observable: The background keys have softer shadows and brighter highlights.
differences.b_observable: The background keys show darker shadows in crevices and higher contrast.
differences.fix: Increase ambient light and soften shadows on the keyboard grid.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame show significant out-of-focus blur.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable a shallower depth of field to blur the corners.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera aperture to replicate the shallow depth of field and corner blur of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with darker corners and edges.
differences.b_observable: Flat lighting across the frame with minimal corner shading.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to darken the corners and match the reference lighting.

differences.a_observable: The yellow and blue keys display highly saturated, rich colors.
differences.b_observable: The yellow and blue keys are desaturated and look washed out.
differences.fix: Increase color saturation on the key materials to match the reference.

differences.a_observable: The background keys are heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background keys remain relatively sharp, indicating a deeper depth of field.
differences.fix: Adjust camera aperture settings to increase depth of field blur in the background.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera depth of field and vignette to match the soft, focused look of the reference video.
